name: keep-word-position
description:
Words by their place in the phrase; exactly one way to pick them is given, N counts from 1.

first / last: the first or last N words.
nth: the N-th word.
to_middle / at_most: the leading words while they hold half the characters of the phrase at most, or N characters at most, and always the first word («купить диван недорого», 12 characters at most → «купить диван»).

remove gives the other words.

keep-word-position keeps only the rows where the matcher finds something in the working column.

Example: semkit read core.csv keep-word-position --nth 3 write out.csv
